root.name: エバーソース・エナジー

relations.text: NSTAR Electricは、同社から再生可能な水力電力を買う20年の契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: NSTAR Electric has a 20-year power purchase agreement with Hydro-Quebec for hydroelectric energy

source.label: Eversource 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: NSTAR Electric entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement for the purchase of renewable hydroelectric energy and renewable energy attributes from Hydro-Québec.

relations.text: NSTAR Electricは、同社の送電線を使う20年の送電サービス契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: NSTAR Electric has a 20-year transmission service agreement with NECEC Transmission

source.label: Eversource 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: In June 2018, in connection with the Hydro-Québec power purchase agreement, NSTAR Electric entered into a 20-year transmission service agreement (TSA) with NECEC Transmission LLC, the developer and owner of the NECEC transmission line.

companies.name: ヴィンヤード・ウィンド

relations.text: NSTAR Electricは、同社の洋上風力発電の電力を長期で購入する契約を持っている
relations.text_en: NSTAR Electric holds a long-term purchase contract with Vineyard Wind

source.label: Eversource 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: Renewable energy purchase contracts include long-term commitments of NSTAR Electric pertaining to the Vineyard Wind LLC contract awarded under the Massachusetts Clean Energy 83C procurement solicitation.

relations.text: NSTAR GasとEGMAは、同社から天然ガスの輸送・貯蔵などのサービスを買っている
relations.text_en: NSTAR Gas and EGMA buy transportation, storage and balancing services from Tennessee Gas Pipeline

source.label: Eversource 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: NSTAR Gas and EGMA purchase transportation, storage, and balancing services from Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company and Algonquin Gas Transmission Company, as well as other upstream pipelines
